The Story Behind the Mission

Meet Laura.

Credit Repair Specialist & Founder

18 years of caring for people. One personal struggle. And a mission that changed everything.

Her Story

Laura Marquez

Founder, GNI Consulting Services

Born and raised in California, Laura spent over 18 years in the medical field — caring for patients across a variety of specialties. Whether she was at the bedside of a patient or supporting a family through a difficult moment, one thing never changed: her belief that making a positive difference in someone's life is one of the most rewarding things you can do.

That same calling is what brought her to credit repair — only this time, the lives she's changing are financial ones.

18+ Years Helping People
3 Bureaus Mastered
100% Client Focused
“

I know what it feels like to be told “no” because of your credit. I also know the hope and confidence that comes from seeing your score improve — and realizing that your goals are finally within reach.

— Laura Marquez, Founder

The Journey

From Patient Care to Financial Empowerment

A Career Built on Caring

For nearly two decades, Laura worked across the medical field — not because it was easy, but because helping people was what she was built to do. From California to Las Vegas, her career was defined by compassion and commitment to the people in front of her.

The Wake-Up Call

When Laura set out to buy her first home, she hit a wall she didn't see coming. Her credit was standing between her and one of her biggest dreams. It was frustrating, discouraging, and overwhelming — feelings she now understands deeply in every client she works with.

She Chose Education Over Defeat

Instead of giving up, Laura committed to learning everything she could about how credit works. She corrected mistakes, developed better financial habits, and stayed consistent through the process — the same process she now walks her clients through.

She Became a Homeowner

Through determination and consistency, Laura achieved her goal. That milestone didn't just change her life — it changed her purpose. She realized that this experience was exactly what someone else needed to hear, and that she had the tools to help them get there too.

GNI Consulting Services Was Born

Laura founded GNI Consulting Services to help individuals and families repair, build, and strengthen their credit — so they can qualify for homes, vehicles, business funding, and opportunities that can genuinely change their lives. The same compassion she brought to healthcare, she now brings to your financial future.

“My goal isn’t just to help improve your credit score — it’s to educate you, empower you, and give you the tools to build lasting financial confidence.”

What We Stand For

The Principles Behind Every Client We Serve

Honesty

We tell you exactly where you stand and what's realistically possible — no promises we can't keep, no surprises along the way.

Compassion

Laura has been where you are. Every client is treated with the same care and respect she would have wanted on her own journey.

Empowerment

We don't just fix your score and send you on your way. We make sure you understand your credit so you can protect and grow it long after we're done.
